It has won and been nominated for thirteen Independent Press Awards. The archive of back issues is now available at emagazine.com, with new editorial content provided by its sister site, EarthTalk.org, the online home of the internationally syndicated EarthTalk Q&A column. EarthTalk is produced by Doug Moss and Roddy Scheer.
